title: Compatible K-flat representatives of a semilinear coefficient tower
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $O$, and a scheme $T$. Put $R=\mathcal O_{E,T}$ and $B_n=(O/\ell^n)_T$ for $n\geq1$, and let $\operatorname{Tow}(T,O)$ be the abelian category of semilinear coefficient towers [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. Let $C_\bullet\in D(\operatorname{Tow}(T,O))$, with exact derived evaluations $C_n\in D(B_n)$ and transitions $t_n:C_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_{B_{n+1}\to B_n}C_n$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. There exist complexes $Q_n$ of $B_n$-modules, K-flat with flat terms [def-pc-kflat-complex], semilinear chain maps $q_n:Q_{n+1}\to Q_n$, and isomorphisms $e_n:Q_n\xrightarrow{\sim}C_n$ in $D(B_n)$ such that $\operatorname{Res}(e_n)\circ Q(q_n)=t_n\circ e_{n+1}$ in $D(B_{n+1})$; here $Q$ denotes localization and the restriction is along $B_{n+1}\to B_n$. The longer chain transitions are composites and represent all the original composite transitions.

After restricting scalars to $R$, this compatible family lifts to an isomorphism in $D(\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}},\operatorname{Mod}(R)))$ between the strict $R$-tower $Q_\bullet$ and the levelwise restriction of $C_\bullet$. Its evaluations are the specified $e_n$; applying total derived inverse limit respects every evaluation projection [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. Only existence of such a lift is asserted. For every $1\leq m\leq n$, the chain map $Q_n\otimes_{B_n}B_m\to Q_m$, $x\otimes b\mapsto bq_{n,m}(x)$, represents, via the $e_n$ and K-flat change of rings [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], the original canonical reduction map $C_n\otimes^L_{B_n}B_m\to C_m$ in $D(B_m)$.
